name: erp_items_list
description: List items in the GTM catalog (licenses, data feeds, services, appliances), optionally filtered by item type or inactive flag (GET /services/rest/record/v1/serviceItem, also inventoryItem/nonInventoryItem)

type.description: Item type filter: inventoryItem, nonInventoryItem or serviceItem.

is_inactive.description: Set 1 to list only retired items, 0 for active items (isInactive).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 30).
